title: GP Role Installer (IS-U)
text:
GP Role Installer (IS-U)
GP Role Installer (IS-U)
Definition
An
installer
is a person licensed by a utilities company to carry out installation work.
Structure
You need the role ISUI and the role category ISUI for the BP role
Installer (IS-U)
.
In addition to the address data, you can also enter status management and general data using this role. In the general data you can define data such as license for certain divisions, operating purpose of the company and the identification number of the license. In the status management you can define data such as the type of license and the date of the initial license.
